protocol.name: reprise_input_v1
protocol.copyright: reprise private protocol: input injection and capture for reprise-portal.

interface.name: reprise_input_v1

description.summary: EIS sockets and pointer barriers for the portal

interface.description: One global. connect_eis hands the compositor one end of a socketpair to run libei's EIS side on; create_capture makes an object that owns pointer barriers and reports when the pointer crosses one. create_shortcuts makes an object that receives one program's global shortcuts. create_keys makes an object that presses keys for one RemoteDesktop session. watch_sandboxed makes an object that lists the sandboxed apps with a window. pick_color opens the colour picker. remote_capture marks a capture connection as the remote desktop server's. lock_screen starts lock mode for the remote desktop server.

entry.name: remote_session
entry.summary: a sender for Reprise's own remote desktop server

entry.name: invalid_kind
entry.summary: kind is not sender or receiver

entry.name: capture_required
entry.summary: a receiver needs a capture object

entry.name: capture_forbidden
entry.summary: a sender must not pass a capture object

entry.name: too_many
entry.summary: more captures, barriers or shortcut objects than the compositor keeps

enum.name: device

description.summary: what an EIS client may be given

enum.description: Bits of connect_eis's devices mask: the RemoteDesktop portal's device types, so a client granted the pointer alone is never offered a keyboard.

entry.name: pointer
entry.summary: relative and absolute pointer, buttons, scroll

request.name: connect_eis

description.summary: run an EIS server on this socket

request.description: The fd is one end of a SOCK_STREAM socketpair; the other end goes to the libei client. A receiver must pass the capture it belongs to; a sender passes null. Only the devices in the mask are advertised to the client and bound for it. A remote_session is a sender with someone at the other end: while it has a device, screen off and idle suspend wait and a shut lid only darkens the panel. The portal uses it for the session it starts without a dialog for the remote desktop server, and plain sender for every other.

request.name: create_shortcuts

description.summary: receive one program's global shortcuts

request.description: The compositor takes the chords of the [[global_shortcuts]] entries whose app is app_id for as long as at least one object for that app exists, and reports their presses and releases here.

request.name: create_keys

description.summary: press keys for one RemoteDesktop session

request.description: The portal makes one for a session granted the keyboard, and sends the session's NotifyKeyboardKeycode and NotifyKeyboardKeysym calls through it.

request.name: watch_sandboxed

description.summary: list the sandboxed apps with a window

request.description: For the Background portal, which tells a sandboxed app running without a window from one with a window whose own app id differs from its sandbox's (an X11 client's class, an Electron app).

request.name: pick_color

description.summary: let the user pick a colour on screen

request.description: For the Screenshot portal's PickColor: the compositor opens its colour picker and answers on the new object.

request.name: remote_capture

description.summary: this connection captures for the remote desktop server

request.description: The portal sends it on the connection that captures the screen for the session it starts without a dialog for the remote desktop server, before it opens the capture session. For the rest of the connection its captures still count as sharing, but get the red capture border only with [remote_desktop] capture_border.

request.name: lock_screen

description.summary: give the remote client screens of its own

request.description: The portal makes one for each session it starts without a dialog for the remote desktop server in lock mode. While at least one lives, the computer's own screens show the session lock and the desktop moves to virtual screens laid out as the first object's set_layout asks.

interface.name: reprise_lock_screen_v1

description.summary: one session's hold on lock mode

interface.description: The object hears ended(unavailable) while [power] locker is set and ended(replaced) while a locker client holds the session lock, when it is made or at its first set_layout, and nothing is created. Otherwise the first object's first set_layout creates one virtual screen per monitor and locks the session if it isn't locked. Only that object's later layouts resize them; once it is destroyed, no layout applies until the last object goes. A later object's first set_layout hears the screens that exist. Lock mode lasts until the last object is destroyed, until a locker client takes the lock, which sends every object ended(replaced), or until the session is unlocked at the computer, which sends every object ended(console_unlocked). Either ended first disconnects every EIS sender and revokes every reprise_keys_v1 object. The lock stays after all but the console unlock.

entry.name: console_unlocked
entry.summary: the session was unlocked at the computer

entry.name: replaced
entry.summary: a locker client holds the session lock

request.name: set_layout

description.summary: the client's monitors

request.description: Each entry is x, y, width and height as int and the scale in percent as uint, in the client's physical pixels, primary first. A layout is ignored with no entry, more than 16, a partial entry, a side outside 200 to 8192, or an x or y beyond 131072 either way.

event.name: screen

description.summary: a virtual screen made for this lock mode

event.description: Sent once per screen, primary first, then done: after each layout change and after this object's first set_layout. The name is the wl_output's.

event.name: done

description.summary: the screens are all sent

event.description: The screen events since the last done are the whole list; it replaces the one before.

event.name: ended

description.summary: lock mode is over for this object

event.description: Nothing more is sent; the portal destroys the object.

interface.name: reprise_eis_client_v1

description.summary: one EIS client

interface.description: Destroying it disconnects the libei client and releases every key and button it holds.

interface.name: reprise_keys_v1

description.summary: one session's keyboard, without libei

interface.description: Keys go to this desktop the way a sender's libei keys do. Destroying it releases every key it holds.

request.name: keysym

description.summary: press or release the key that types a keysym

request.description: The key is the lowest keycode giving the keysym at the first level of the current layout, else at the lowest level any key gives it at. No modifier is pressed for a higher level. A keysym no key gives is dropped. A release lets go of the key its press went down on.

interface.name: reprise_input_capture_v1

description.summary: pointer barriers and the captured state

interface.description: Barriers are lines in layout coordinates, axis aligned, on the outer edge of the union of the outputs (the portal checks that; the compositor drops anything that is not axis aligned). While enabled, a physical pointer motion that would cross a barrier stops there, activated is sent, and physical input goes to the receiver EIS client bound to this capture until release.

request.name: release

description.summary: end the active capture

request.description: With has_position nonzero the cursor is warped to (x, y) first. A stale activation_id is ignored; activation_id 0 means the current activation, whatever it is.

arg.name: x
arg.summary: where the pointer would have gone, unclamped

event.name: zones_changed

description.summary: the output layout changed

event.description: The barrier set was cleared and the capture disabled; the portal re-reads the zones and sets barriers again.

interface.name: reprise_shortcuts_v1

description.summary: one program's global shortcuts

interface.description: A press of a bound chord goes to no window: activated is sent, and deactivated when that key comes up, whatever the modifiers are by then. The release reaches no window either.

description.summary: this app's entries changed in the config

interface.name: reprise_color_pick_v1

description.summary: one colour pick

interface.description: Exactly one of picked or cancelled is sent. A picker already open cancels this one at once. Destroying the object before the answer closes the picker.

interface.name: reprise_sandboxed_v1

description.summary: the sandbox app ids of the clients with a mapped window

interface.description: On creation and whenever the set changes, the compositor sends one app event per app id in the set, then done. A done after no app event means the set is empty. The app id is the Flatpak id of the client's sandbox: its security context's, or the one in its process's /.flatpak-info; for an X11 window, the X client's.
